verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal links to a first-party API Reference (for example, the readUserCallLog endpoint) and offers a 'Your first API call' guide, so an API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe returning 404 only means no spec was found at standard paths; it does not show the reference lacks interactivity. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples within the reference, a downloadable or machine-readable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
